current.text: Charlotte traded LaMelo Ball to Minnesota and Miles Bridges to Phoenix, which leaves a lot of usage open.
Experts expect Miller to take on more of the creation role without LaMelo Ball. They see his usage rising from about 28 to 29 or 30, with more assists and possibly lower efficiency.
He could become a four-threes-a-game player in the new Charlotte situation.
He is a projected starter for Charlotte with White, Knueppel, Reid and Diabaté. Ball handling is split among White, Knueppel and Miller, with no single primary creator.
Coby White is out with a calf injury and will probably miss the start of the season. Kon Knueppel is also hurt, so Miller is the last healthy main player in Charlotte.
While White is out, Miller should get a high workload, big minutes and more playmaking, though he may shoot poorly.
He had shoulder surgery after last season and had no shoulder restrictions heading into training camp.
His preseason injury flag is not a worry.
Experts value him as a late round 2 to round 3 pick in 9-cat, around picks 25 to 34, and a top 30 season is possible. Mock drafters took him at 25 and 34 and called 28 to 30 a good spot.
Josh named him a target in an auction mock and bought him for 26 USD.
Experts call his market price too low, especially on ESPN, where an ADP of 107 is called 'bonkers'. Going at pick 49 is called way too late.
He should improve on last season, but that is not guaranteed.
Charlotte takes many threes and spaces the floor.
For a March 28 end, Charlotte plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. It has only 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum.
Charlotte's two-game week starting March 1 falls before our playoffs and should not factor into decisions about him.

durable.text: Threes made are his standout category, far above the pool and very high for a forward.
He is not a strong FG% player, and his FG% is weak for a forward on high volume.
He commits many turnovers for a forward.
His drives often stall, which leads to many mid-range shots. He finishes well at the rim but rarely gets there.
He gets injured often. He had shoulder surgery after the 2025-26 season.
He is worth more in category leagues than in ESPN points leagues.

note: Experts treat Miller as a late round 2 to round 3 player, which is close to his Yahoo value (26 USD, rank 35). ESPN (9 USD, rank 55) and our league's 20 USD from last season both sit lower, so a price of about 20 to 26 USD fits. He brings elite threes for a forward, strong FT% (about 88%) and points, so he fits punt FG% and punt TO builds best, since about 43% FG on 17 to 18 shots and 2.7 turnovers are his costs. Early in the season, check that the shoulder holds up, and watch his usage, assists and FG% while Coby White is out.
